subject: Estimating density using a set sigma value

messages.author: 665a85521cbc65e4
messages.subject: Estimating density using a set sigma value
parts:
Hi Murray/all,

I hope you are doing well.

My name is Paolo Strampelli, and I am a researcher focussing on lions at the NGO Panthera. I had a question for which I was not able to find an answer in the package documentation. 

Is it possible to fit a model and estimate density using a pre-set value of sigma that we can define in the code? i.e. estimate density from a capture history and trap layout file, but instead of estimating sigma from these data - and using this to then estimate density - it estimates what the density would be if sigma was this pre-defined value.

I hope I've explained myself clearly - please let me know if not. I also realise this may not be possible, but I thought I'd check if this was something that had been developed already.

Thanks in advance for any assistance.

All the best,
Paolo

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Estimating density using a set sigma value
parts: Try something like secr.fit(..., fixed = list(sigma = 2000))
